name: Majokko a la Mode II ~Hikari to Yami no Etranger~
original_name: 魔女っ娘ア・ラ・モードII～光と闇のエトランゼ～
source:
Story takes place in Twinkle City long before the foundation of Mint Kingdom.
Main character Lyle is an apprentice wizard who is currently training at the Magical Academy. He spends days peacefully with his girlfriend Jessica.
One day a mysterious girl appears in front of him, and strange events start to pile up. Protagonist gathers girls to repel the invading monsters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在薄荷王国建立很久以前的Twinkle City。
主人公莱尔是一名正在魔法学院修行的见习魔法师，与女朋友杰西卡过着平静生活。
一天，一名神秘少女出现在他面前，此后怪事不断发生。主人公召集女孩们，共同击退入侵的怪物。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
